name: Netorare Jukubo Natsuko (41) ~Wakai Otoko to no Hentai Sex ni Hamatta Hontou wa Dosukebe Datta Okaa-san~
original_name: 寝取られ熟母夏子(41)～若い男との変態セックスにハマッた本当はドスケベだったお母さん～
source:
Me and my mother lived in a two-person apartment.
Everything was fine, we weren't rich but it was comfortable.
My father had died when I was young, leaving mom to
raise me. She had her own aspirations, but always put
me first.

Elegant, tender and generous. Very beautiful. I was proud of my mother.
She was mine and mine alone... or so I thought...

Little by little, our happy life began to crumble...

It's all the fault of a classmate I hate... Kazuya Eguchi.

He was shameless, crass, violent...
Everything that was mine, everything I cared about, he destroyed...
That son of a bitch never thought about anyone but himself...
He treated women like disposable sex objects...

The most unforgivable thing is he did it with my mom...
